title: Identification of Mitophagy-Related Genes With Diagnostic Value in Atherosclerosis Using Bioinformatics Analysis and Experiment Validation.
authors: Chen, Zhe; Chen, Zhongying; Wang, Yuhao; Shao, Jianzhi; Wang, Qizeng
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过生物信息学与机器学习识别动脉粥样硬化中线粒体自噬相关诊断基因，虽涉及转录因子调控分析，但核心对象非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无结合建模或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Atherosclerosis (AS) is a chronic inflammatory condition with complex molecular underpinnings, where mitophagy-selective mitochondrial autophagy-plays a critical yet poorly defined role. By integrating bulk and single-cell RNA sequencing data from human atherosclerotic plaques, we analyzed 20 mitophagy-related genes and identified 15 that were dysregulated in AS. Machine learning approaches (Random Forest and SVM-RFE) pinpointed four hub genes-PINK1, TOMM40, TOMM7, and VDAC1-which formed the basis of a diagnostic model with solid predictive performance. Single-cell analysis of over 106,000 cells revealed endothelial cells as mitophagy-active and dominant in AS lesions. Trajectory analysis distinguished disease-associated endothelial subtypes, while CellChat uncovered intensified MIF signaling via CD74-CD44 and CD74-CXCR4 axes in mitophagy-high endothelial cells. SCENIC analysis further identified CEBPD, FOS, and JUN family transcription factors as key regulators. Experimental validation using ox-LDL-treated RAW264.7 macrophages confirmed differential expression of all four hub genes. Collectively, our findings highlight endothelial mitophagy dysregulation and immune crosstalk as central to AS pathogenesis and offer promising diagnostic markers and therapeutic targets.
abstract_zh: 动脉粥样硬化（AS）是一种具有复杂分子基础的慢性炎症性疾病，其中线粒体自噬（mitophagy）——一种选择性的线粒体自噬过程——发挥着关键但尚不明确的作用。通过整合人类动脉粥样硬化斑块的批量及单细胞RNA测序数据，我们分析了20个与线粒体自噬相关的基因，并鉴定出15个在AS中表达失调的基因。机器学习方法（随机森林和SVM-RFE）确定了四个核心基因——PINK1、TOMM40、TOMM7和VDAC1——这些基因构成了一个具有稳健预测性能的诊断模型。对超过106,000个细胞的单细胞分析揭示，内皮细胞在AS病变中表现出高线粒体自噬活性并占据主导地位。轨迹分析区分了疾病相关的内皮细胞亚型，而CellChat分析发现，在线粒体自噬高表达的内皮细胞中，通过CD74-CD44和CD74-CXCR4轴的MIF信号增强。SCENIC分析进一步将CEBPD、FOS和JUN家族转录因子识别为关键调控因子。使用ox-LDL处理的RAW264.7巨噬细胞进行的实验验证确认了所有四个核心基因的差异表达。总体而言，我们的研究结果强调内皮线粒体自噬失调和免疫串扰是AS发病机制的核心，并提供了有前景的诊断标志物和治疗靶点。
